detailed_descriptions.en: Overview: FIRE STATE is a tactical shooter played from a realistic bodycam-style perspective. We aim to strike a careful balance between intense realism and fluid playability, delivering an adrenaline-charged battlefield experience while ensuring that every action feels precise and responsive. Prepare to enter dangerous operational zones, where your body camera will capture every critical moment. In-Depth Overview: Experience tense, high-intensity confrontations through a deeply immersive first-person body camera perspective. We know that pure realism can sometimes come at the cost of accessible controls. That is why, alongside carefully crafting visual fidelity, physical feedback, and environmental audio, our development team has devoted substantial effort to optimizing the controls and player interface. The result delivers the impact of a realistic battlefield while letting you carry out every tactical intention smoothly and confidently. FIRE STATE does more than recreate and refine the traditional shooter experience. It brings together a rich selection of game modes for different types of players. Whether you are a hardcore competitor, a co-op fan who enjoys fighting alongside friends, or an explorer seeking heart-pounding thrills, you can find your own kind of excitement here. Key Features: The world's first FPS game rendered with 3DGS: Through our efforts, 3DGS is no longer just a technical demo video on the internet—it has truly made its way into a game. In our game, you will experience world-leading real-time 3DGS rendering technology. If you want to experience this technology, your search ends here. Highly immersive realistic bodycam-style perspective : Presented through distinctive recorder footage, camera movement and a restricted field of view create authentic pressure and unprecedented tactical depth. Top-tier visuals: Drawing on extensive technical experience and deep optimization for Unreal Engine 5, we deliver industry-leading visual quality. An RTX 3060-class graphics card can maintain smooth performance at maximum graphics settings . A refined balance of realism and playability: Realistic elements such as environmental interaction, ballistic trajectories, and powerful audio are paired with carefully tuned controls, creating a smooth and intuitive experience where hardcore simulation and satisfying gunplay are no longer mutually exclusive. Classic competitive modes: Take on time-tested traditional PVP modes, including Team Deathmatch, Zone Control, and Demolition, and use your marksmanship and tactical judgment to outplay your opponents. Engaging multiplayer co-op campaign (in development): Team up with friends to tackle carefully designed missions, dismantle criminal organizations, and rescue hostages. In environments filled with uncertainty and formidable enemies, close teamwork and strategic communication are essential to overcoming every challenge and completing the mission. Heart-pounding horror levels (in development, coming soon): What happens when tactical shooting meets fear of the unknown? Explore specially designed horror-themed levels, endure oppressive and unsettling atmospheres, and face psychological and survival challenges beyond conventional combat for a completely different kind of thrill. Whether you are a tactical expert seeking an authentic battlefield, a co-op specialist who thrives alongside friends, or a fearless explorer ready to confront the unknown, FIRE STATE delivers a one-of-a-kind experience worth recording. Are you ready to switch on your camera and define your own battlefield legend? “ FIRE STATE ” is independently developed and published by UNDER FIRE. This game is not affiliated with, authorized by, sponsored by, endorsed by, or associated with any third-party game studio, publisher, or trademark owner.

Overview:

FIRE STATE is a tactical shooter played from a realistic bodycam-style perspective. We aim to strike a careful balance between intense realism and fluid playability, delivering an adrenaline-charged battlefield experience while ensuring that every action feels precise and responsive. Prepare to enter dangerous operational zones, where your body camera will capture every critical moment.

In-Depth Overview:

Experience tense, high-intensity confrontations through a deeply immersive first-person body camera perspective. We know that pure realism can sometimes come at the cost of accessible controls. That is why, alongside carefully crafting visual fidelity, physical feedback, and environmental audio, our development team has devoted substantial effort to optimizing the controls and player interface. The result delivers the impact of a realistic battlefield while letting you carry out every tactical intention smoothly and confidently.

FIRE STATE does more than recreate and refine the traditional shooter experience. It brings together a rich selection of game modes for different types of players. Whether you are a hardcore competitor, a co-op fan who enjoys fighting alongside friends, or an explorer seeking heart-pounding thrills, you can find your own kind of excitement here.

Key Features:

  • The world's first FPS game rendered with 3DGS: Through our efforts, 3DGS is no longer just a technical demo video on the internet—it has truly made its way into a game. In our game, you will experience world-leading real-time 3DGS rendering technology. If you want to experience this technology, your search ends here.

  • Highly immersive realistic bodycam-style perspective: Presented through distinctive recorder footage, camera movement and a restricted field of view create authentic pressure and unprecedented tactical depth.

  • Top-tier visuals: Drawing on extensive technical experience and deep optimization for Unreal Engine 5, we deliver industry-leading visual quality. An RTX 3060-class graphics card can maintain smooth performance at maximum graphics settings.

  • A refined balance of realism and playability: Realistic elements such as environmental interaction, ballistic trajectories, and powerful audio are paired with carefully tuned controls, creating a smooth and intuitive experience where hardcore simulation and satisfying gunplay are no longer mutually exclusive.

  • Classic competitive modes: Take on time-tested traditional PVP modes, including Team Deathmatch, Zone Control, and Demolition, and use your marksmanship and tactical judgment to outplay your opponents.

  • Engaging multiplayer co-op campaign (in development): Team up with friends to tackle carefully designed missions, dismantle criminal organizations, and rescue hostages. In environments filled with uncertainty and formidable enemies, close teamwork and strategic communication are essential to overcoming every challenge and completing the mission.

  • Heart-pounding horror levels (in development, coming soon): What happens when tactical shooting meets fear of the unknown? Explore specially designed horror-themed levels, endure oppressive and unsettling atmospheres, and face psychological and survival challenges beyond conventional combat for a completely different kind of thrill.

Whether you are a tactical expert seeking an authentic battlefield, a co-op specialist who thrives alongside friends, or a fearless explorer ready to confront the unknown, FIRE STATE delivers a one-of-a-kind experience worth recording. Are you ready to switch on your camera and define your own battlefield legend?

“FIRE STATE” is independently developed and published by UNDER FIRE. This game is not affiliated with, authorized by, sponsored by, endorsed by, or associated with any third-party game studio, publisher, or trademark owner.
